skill.name: applying-brand-guidelines
skill.description: Applies Acme Corporation brand standards to document configurations and validates content for consistent colors, fonts, tone, layouts, and messaging.
skill.summary: Apply and validate consistent Acme branding across document configurations and written content.

content.value_statement: Teams often produce documents with inconsistent colors, typography, layouts, and messaging. This skill applies Acme standards and checks content for common brand violations.
actual_capabilities: Applies predefined style configurations to Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF document settings.
Defines Acme colors, typography, logo placement, page layouts, slide templates, and table styles.
Validates text for approved colors, fonts, brand name capitalization, tone keywords, and prohibited phrases.
Calculates a brand compliance score and returns violations, warnings, and correction suggestions.
Formats currency, percentages, large numbers, and general numeric values using documented conventions.
Provides chart palettes and draft, confidential, or sample watermark configurations.
limitations: Uses the bundled Acme Corporation example unless users customize the Python constants or load separate guideline data.
Returns document configuration dictionaries; it does not directly create or modify Office or PDF files.
Color correction always suggests Acme Blue instead of calculating the nearest approved color.
Validation uses pattern matching and cannot assess visual layout, logo quality, accessibility, or factual accuracy.

use_cases.title: Standardize Marketing Documents
use_cases.description: Create consistent presentation, spreadsheet, and PDF configurations using approved colors, typography, logos, and messaging.

use_cases.title: Review Brand Compliance
use_cases.description: Check draft content for unapproved colors, fonts, prohibited phrases, and incorrect brand name capitalization.

use_cases.title: Automate Document Styling
use_cases.description: Integrate reusable brand settings, chart palettes, number formats, and watermarks into document generation workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Branding
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Acme brand guidelines to this document outline. Use approved colors, typography, tone, and logo placement.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a branded document structure.

prompt_templates.title: Review Draft Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft against the Acme guidelines. List color, font, tone, messaging, and brand name issues with specific corrections.
prompt_templates.scenario: A content owner needs a compliance review.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Branded Presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a presentation configuration for this brief. Include title, content, data slide styles, chart colors, footer settings, and accessibility checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs detailed presentation standards.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Custom Brand Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the bundled validation and formatting approach to these brand rules. Identify required guideline fields, validation gaps, configuration changes, and testing criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs an advanced implementation plan.

output_examples.input: Review a quarterly report using an unapproved red, Comic Sans, and lowercase acme corporation.
output_examples.output: Compliance score: 70. Violations: replace the red with an approved color, use Segoe UI, and capitalize Acme Corporation correctly.

output_examples.input: Prepare styling guidance for a confidential PowerPoint business review.
output_examples.output: Use Acme Blue title areas, white title text, Segoe UI body text, approved chart colors, standard footers, and a confidential watermark.

output_examples.input: Format revenue of 1250000 and growth of 8.25 percent for an executive summary.
output_examples.output: Present revenue as $1,250,000.00, abbreviated revenue as 1.2M, and growth as 8.2%.

best_practices: Replace the bundled Acme values with current, approved organizational guidelines before production use.
Provide the document type, audience, classification, and source content when requesting branded output.
Review generated configurations and validation results with the brand team before publishing external communications.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the generated configuration as a finished Office or PDF document.
Do not assume pattern-based validation can verify visual quality, accessibility, or factual accuracy.
Do not mix unofficial colors, fonts, logos, or messaging with approved brand elements.

faq.question: Which document types are supported?
faq.answer: The formatter provides configurations for Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF documents.

faq.question: Does the skill create finished files?
faq.answer: No. It returns formatting configurations that another document library or workflow must apply.

faq.question: Can I use my own brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace the bundled constants or load compatible guideline data from a local JSON file.

faq.question: What does the validator check?
faq.answer: It checks colors, font declarations, tone keywords, prohibited phrases, and brand name capitalization.

faq.question: How is the compliance score calculated?
faq.answer: The validator starts at 100, subtracts ten points per violation, and subtracts three points per warning.

faq.question: Does it verify accessibility?
faq.answer: No. The references include contrast and font guidance, but the validator does not calculate accessibility compliance.
